subject.title: [Feature Request]: one-line local bootstrap for daemon + dashboard auth + Telegram owner setup

question: Should OpenClaw ship an official one-line localhost + Telegram owner bootstrap surface, and should it use numeric allowlist/preapproval rather than pairing auto-approval?
rationale: The implementation would add public setup CLI/installer surface and choose a first-run trust model for dashboard auth tokens and Telegram DM ownership, which needs maintainer product and security intent before coding.

options.title: Sponsor scoped secure bootstrap
options.body: Add a documented local bootstrap path that requires explicit risk acknowledgement, uses numeric Telegram owner IDs or a bounded preapproval, and leaves normal pairing semantics intact.

options.title: Keep composed commands only
options.body: Document the existing onboarding, dashboard, channels add, channels resolve, and allowlist steps without adding a new wrapper command or installer mode.

options.title: Split into narrower security work
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella but land only the narrower Telegram owner allowlist/default decisions through the linked issues first.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped secure bootstrap
recommendation.body: Add a documented local bootstrap path that requires explicit risk acknowledgement, uses numeric Telegram owner IDs or a bounded preapproval, and leaves normal pairing semantics intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest recent owner in the inspected setup and Telegram source history, though final security/product approval may need broader maintainer review.
